long_biography.plain_text:
Raymond Tantillo's dealership business connects customers with stock held across the Tantillo Auto Group network. A buyer seeking a particular vehicle can ask the group to locate it beyond the inventory advertised by an individual outlet. Its retail operations span several manufacturers and offer both new and used vehicles.

The group has also taken its branding into American motor racing. In 2025 it backed Mason Maggio's Chevrolet Silverado for Hettinger Racing at the opening NASCAR Truck Series race at Daytona. Maggio drove the number four entry, carrying the dealership group's name, and completed the race in fifteenth place.
